
Leaflet 1.9.4 (vendored from npm, BSD-2-Clause)
Files: leaflet.min.js, leaflet.css, leaflet-images/*
Source: https://registry.npmjs.org/leaflet/-/leaflet-1.9.4.tgz
Why vendored: the Government GIS Risk Map must render even when the
unpkg CDN is unreachable (offline/restricted networks); Leaflet is a
small (~42 KB gzipped) library, so a local copy does not bloat the page.
